name: bili-clean-follow-promo

scripts.render: node tools/gen_bgm.mjs && remotion render BiliCleanPromo out/bili-clean-promo.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.render:walk: node tools/gen_bgm.mjs && remotion render Walkthrough out/bili-clean-walkthrough.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.render:master: npm run render && npm run render:walk
scripts.render:v2: node tools/fill_numbers.mjs && node tools/gen_bgm.mjs --frames 1800 --out public/audio/bgm-v2-promo.wav && remotion render BiliCleanV2Promo out/bili-clean-v2-promo.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.render:v2:walk: node tools/fill_numbers.mjs && node tools/gen_bgm.mjs --frames 2700 --out public/audio/bgm-v2-walk.wav && remotion render WalkthroughV2 out/bili-clean-v2-walkthrough.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.film:v2: node tools/fill_numbers.mjs && node tools/capture_ui.mjs && npm run render:v2 && npm run render:v2:walk && node tools/make_gifs.mjs

description: Remotion project for the bili-clean-follow product & walkthrough videos
